subject: english
prompt: 在「比較分類排序」單元的英文練習中，Choose the correct sentence for a daily habit.

options.text: Mia go to school by bus every day.
Mia goes to school by bus every day.
Mia going to school by bus every day.
Mia gone to school by bus every day.

answer.explanation: 主詞 Mia 為第三人稱單數，現在簡單式動詞用 goes。 本題置於「比較分類排序」單元語境中，需先理解句意或文法功能再作答。
